text: Producer prices shift into positive growth after a prolonged contraction while input costs rise faster than output prices. Consumer inflation remains comparatively muted despite upstream pressure. Industrial margins compress as cost increases are not fully transmitted through to end pricing, with policy measures partially constraining downstream price expansion.

meta.note: Inversion applies to producer pricing regime shift, not full system-wide inflation alignment.

text: Consumer price index rises sharply due to energy cost surge while core inflation remains subdued. Energy-driven components dominate headline movement as non-energy categories show limited change or decline. Real earnings decrease as wage growth trails price increases, with underlying inflation measures remaining within constrained ranges.

meta.note: Inversion applies to headline inflation shift without corresponding core inflation expansion.
